final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_account_links FROM disp AS p JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT region, client_account_links, CAST(client_account_links AS REAL) / SUM(client_account_links) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), above_average AS (SELECT client_account_links, share FROM region_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)) SELECT SUM(client_account_links) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM region_shares)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
